device: single hBN-encapsulated monolithic graphene bridge only, published Fig2a and Fig2b electrical-resistance axes
input_projection: sealed until registration; admit RGB, gate x and per-axis labels already read. Only resistance and 5/30K hot/cold noise deltas in forecast worker; 20K hot AND cold opened only jointly by scorer after all forecast banks. Numeric Y of Fig2 thermal conductance/Lorenz panels and CNT figures prohibited.
group: 5K blue211 native gates [-7,7],20K yellow121 [-7,5] entire held H,C,30K red121 [-7,5]; both donors interpolated onto each full goal grid. Three temperatures on one specimen. Known result/figure descriptions have been read, no numeric ordinate used for freeze.
style_uncertainty: For R the 211-point shade is 5K. Score both ways of assigning the two 121-point blue shades to 20/30K regardless of electrical-only registration outcome; any primary success must hold for both. Distinct measurement and alignment of gate grids within each curve; cannot infer joint clock or shared fluctuations from coindexed plots.
measurement: Let H=hot and C=cold measured Johnson noise rises in Kelvin (native figure text). R is published electrical kOhm. Ideal lossless geometry uses hot peak=1.5H, cold peak=2C, Q=(2/3) Gcold C. Then Y=H−4C/3 proportional to C R/L. Unmeasured Gcold, unknown specimen calibration and temperature dependence imply only gate-shape equivalence up to one positive scalar per temperature. No absolute Lorenz, heat-current, thermal-conductance, per-gate calibration or intrinsic-material identification.
source_method: Use all native donor gates and positive quadrature (endpoint half-width, interior half neighbor gap). For each t and beta form U=C*R^beta and Y=H−4C/3. For target g use weighted constant least-square coefficient f(g)=sum wj Kj Uj Yj / sum wj Kj Uj², Gaussian Kj with sd 0.35 V (no fit-selected cutoff). This avoids dividing by individual temperature measurements. On held grid separately scale each donor f to unit positive RMS using full target gate quadrature, then weight donors 0.4,0.6 from linear temperature weights, giving fbar(g). Predict V=Rheld^beta*fbar. Primary beta=1. All models full gate vectors, preserved even with signed coefficients; no outcome clipping or exclusions. Use nonnegative gain only in scoring.
controls: direct measured temperature-shape transfer beta=0 with identical kernel and donor weights

train-only free resistance exponent from [-1,0,0.5,1,1.5,2] and bandwidth [.15,.35,.70,1.4] V; select by mean of reciprocal donor-to-donor positive-gain normalized residuals on common support [-7,5] using all donor rows in each fit, deterministic lexicographic first minimizing loss; evaluate full held gate grid at selected parameters

two-temperature empirical ridge at measured R and gate: for each donor normalize auxiliary V=Y/C via same local WLS beta0/bandwidth. Build common polynomial B=(1,g/7,(g/7)^2,(g/7)^3, log(R),log(R)^2,g/7*log(R)) and donor-specific weighted fit ridge 1e-4 on nonintercept features, trace-normalized positive gate weights. Evaluate both learned coefficient fits on held R,g; normalize each fitted vector to unit RMS and combine 0.4/0.6. Uses both donor thermometry and held measured R. Intercept unpenalized.
scoring: Mass w_i by positive trapezoid gate widths normalized to sum1. V normalized by weighted RMS. U_i=C_held,i V_i, Y_i=H−4C/3. Evaluate s=max(0,sum w UY/sum w U²), weighted residual norm/sqrt(sum w Y²) and maximum of 5 equal-gate-width segment residual RMS divided by all-gate Y RMS with global s shared (closed endpoint final segment). This uses one nuisance scale on entire held trajectory per arm and is explicitly a shape condition, not a forecast of unscaled C. Record entire raw H,C,R, signals V,Y,CV, fitted scale, residuals, per-bin scores, unweighted largest raw residual and gate. No held scale allocated separately per bin.
refusal: All 121 held gates obligatory. Strictly increasing finite x, finite R>0 on every measured stage and uniquely identified H/C legend; both R permutations preserved. No gates removed at any signal sign or floor. Any zero or nonfinite required model design norm, Y norm, or denominator is an explicit full-course failure with support census; no silent ratio regularization. Relative cancellation ||Y||/(||H||+4/3||C||)<.02, or ||C V||/(||C|| max|V|)<.02 for an arm, flags an engineering conditioning refusal for that comparison. Include all raw scores and diagnostics on finite support, print signs/min/max and norms. Training-only zero local normal-equation norm or fit error fails; no model substitution. Positive-norm equality gate uses strict inequality, no tie credit.
primary: For BOTH possible R label permutations projected physical beta=1 donor mixture must beat every control in full-gate normalized residual and largest gate-segment residual. Report every arm including equal learned-beta ties, separate each assignment, no partial pass, no IID or confidence interval across gates. Relative source gate-shape under ideal geometry only; replicate/noise calibration absent.
electrical_registration: Optional separate independent R-only registration uses published PDF electrical panel crop in page coordinates x330..475,y87..172 (points from top, page3). Use declared shared gate axis near x=413.18+11.11*g and resistance y=176.97−18.685*R. Public R-only overlay, no thermal panel decoding. If registration ambiguous or fails both permutations remain compulsory, no selecting by held thermometry.
